# apicp_account_backup (Resource)

Takes one backup of an `apicp_account` - everything it owns (website docroots, mailboxes, database dumps) in a single archive stored on apicp. It is a point-in-time snapshot: applying creates one backup, and a later apply does not take another. To take a fresh one, replace the resource (`terraform apply -replace=...`, or `replace_triggered_by`). Destroying deletes the stored backup. Restoring is an action, not a state, so it is not exposed here - use `POST /v1/accounts/{id}/backups/{backup_id}/restore` on apicp's API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apicp_account_backup" "nightly" {
  account_id = apicp_account.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) ID of the `apicp_account` to back up. Changing this replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the backup was taken (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Size of the stored archive.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apicp_account_backup.nightly acct_abc123/bkp_xyz789
```
